findings.text: The new folders `ai/cards/` and `ai/rail/` have no `readme.md` and no `page.js`, yet `ai/readme.md` now links to them as `[cards/](cards/)` and `[rail/](rail/)`. Those links reach no real page, which breaks "Everything is linked" and "every module has a readme.md" (Requirement 4). Evidence: `ls public/framework/ai/cards public/framework/ai/rail` shows only code and `files.jsonl`.

The class files kept their lowercase names (`cards/card.js`, `rail/rail.js` …). The brief asked for "class folders … one class per file named for the class". STATE.md records this as deferred because of the number of callers. That is reasonable, but it is still open work: it should go on the card as a follow-up, not only into STATE.md.

`ai/readme.md`, under "Start here", still says "[AI 2](/framework/ai2/): the dashboard". The `ai2/page.js` route alias still titles itself "AI 2", with its own tabs. The old address keeps working as asked, but it still reads as a second dashboard, which is the "zombie" the owner wanted gone. Retitle the alias page, or point it at `/framework/ai/`.

Some code comments still name the old paths `ai2/rail.css`, `ai2/doc/*.md` and `ai2/processes.css` (`ux/Card/Card.css:12,1513`, `ux/Inbox/Inbox.css:7-8`, `ai/v/3/v3.css:259`, `ext/drawer/rail.js:269`, `ai/cards/card.js:872`, `ai2/ai2.css:10`). They break nothing, but they send readers to files that have moved.

`/framework/core/Page/overview/folders/` shows "Page Load Error" (a 404) at all four widths. This change did not cause it: the diff only edits a comment there, and `core/Page/overview/` has no `page.js`, so the page was already unreachable before this work.
